req.title: Honour Accept: application/json
req.statement: The system shall respect an Accept: application/json request header by serialising responses as JSON.

doc.reasoning: The requirement mandates that when a client sends Accept: application/json, the server must respond with JSON-serialised content. Tests cover: (1) positive EP — standard GET /get with Accept: application/json yields 200 and JSON content-type; (2) positive EP — POST /post with Accept: application/json yields 200 and JSON; (3) positive EP — GET /headers with Accept: application/json yields 200 and JSON with headers key; (4) positive EP — GET /cookies with Accept: application/json yields 200 and JSON with cookies key; (5) positive EP — GET /basic-auth with correct credentials and Accept: application/json yields 200 with authenticated=true; (6) negative NEG — GET /basic-auth with wrong credentials yields 401; (7) boundary BVA — Accept header with application/json alongside wildcard */* still returns JSON; (8) DT — PUT /put with Accept: application/json yields 200 and JSON; (9) DT — DELETE /delete with Accept: application/json yields 200 and JSON; (10) BVA — PATCH /patch with Accept: application/json yields 200 and JSON. Mutation resilience is achieved by asserting exact status codes (200, 401), exact Content-Type values, and exact JSON keys present in responses.

tests.name: test_get_accept_json_returns_200_and_json_content_type
preconditions: httpbin Flask app is importable in-process
GET /get endpoint is available
actions: Create test client from httpbin app
Send GET /get with Accept: application/json header
expected: Response body is valid JSON with keys: url, args, headers, origin
trace: R-HTTPBIN-037: Accept: application/json must yield JSON response
tests.executable:
from httpbin.core import app
import json

def test_get_accept_json_returns_200_and_json_content_type():
    client = app.test_client()
    r = client.get('/get', headers={'Accept': 'application/json'})
    assert r.status_code == 200
    ct = r.headers.get('Content-Type', '')
    assert 'application/json' in ct
    body = json.loads(r.data.decode('utf-8'))
    assert 'url' in body
    assert 'args' in body
    assert 'headers' in body
    assert 'origin' in body

test_get_accept_json_returns_200_and_json_content_type()

tests.executable:
from httpbin.core import app
import json

def test_post_accept_json_returns_200_and_json_content_type():
    client = app.test_client()
    r = client.post(
        '/post',
        headers={'Accept': 'application/json'},
        data={'key': 'value'},
        content_type='application/x-www-form-urlencoded'
    )
    assert r.status_code == 200
    ct = r.headers.get('Content-Type', '')
    assert 'application/json' in ct
    body = json.loads(r.data.decode('utf-8'))
    assert 'url' in body
    assert 'form' in body
    assert 'headers' in body
    assert body['form'] == {'key': 'value'}

test_post_accept_json_returns_200_and_json_content_type()

tests.name: test_basic_auth_success_accept_json_returns_authenticated_true
preconditions: httpbin Flask app is importable in-process
GET /basic-auth/<user>/<passwd> endpoint is available
actions: Create test client from httpbin app
Send GET /basic-auth/user/passwd with correct Basic auth credentials and Accept: application/json
expected: Response body JSON has authenticated=true and user='user'
trace: R-HTTPBIN-037: /basic-auth endpoint must honour Accept: application/json on success
tests.executable:
from httpbin.core import app
import json
import base64

def test_basic_auth_success_accept_json_returns_authenticated_true():
    client = app.test_client()
    creds = base64.b64encode(b'user:passwd').decode('ascii')
    r = client.get(
        '/basic-auth/user/passwd',
        headers={
            'Accept': 'application/json',
            'Authorization': 'Basic ' + creds
        }
    )
    assert r.status_code == 200
    ct = r.headers.get('Content-Type', '')
    assert 'application/json' in ct
    body = json.loads(r.data.decode('utf-8'))
    assert body['authenticated'] == True
    assert body['user'] == 'user'

test_basic_auth_success_accept_json_returns_authenticated_true()

tests.name: test_basic_auth_wrong_credentials_returns_401
preconditions: httpbin Flask app is importable in-process
GET /basic-auth/<user>/<passwd> endpoint is available
actions: Create test client from httpbin app
Send GET /basic-auth/user/passwd with WRONG credentials and Accept: application/json
trace: R-HTTPBIN-037 error pathway: HTTP 4xx on client error
Wrong credentials must yield 401, not a JSON 200
tests.executable:
from httpbin.core import app
import base64

def test_basic_auth_wrong_credentials_returns_401():
    client = app.test_client()
    bad_creds = base64.b64encode(b'user:wrongpassword').decode('ascii')
    r = client.get(
        '/basic-auth/user/passwd',
        headers={
            'Accept': 'application/json',
            'Authorization': 'Basic ' + bad_creds
        }
    )
    assert r.status_code == 401
    assert r.status_code != 200
    assert r.status_code != 403
    assert 'WWW-Authenticate' in r.headers

test_basic_auth_wrong_credentials_returns_401()

from httpbin.core import app
import json

def test_patch_accept_json_returns_200_and_json():
    client = app.test_client()
    payload = json.dumps({'foo': 'bar'})
    r = client.patch(
        '/patch',
        headers={
            'Accept': 'application/json',
            'Content-Type': 'application/json'
        },
        data=payload
    )
    assert r.status_code == 200
    ct = r.headers.get('Content-Type', '')
    assert 'application/json' in ct
    body = json.loads(r.data.decode('utf-8'))
    assert 'json' in body
    assert body['json'] == {'foo': 'bar'}

test_patch_accept_json_returns_200_and_json()
